purpose: Teach: みなす/逃れる/しようが/見なさ/傾き/負い/懲り/劣る

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、人は皆を仲間とみなす時代だった
lines.en: You know, when I was young, everyone looked out for each other like we were all family.
lines.style: Soft, measured opening. Eyes slightly distant with memory. Quiet warmth underneath—not sad, just reflective. Deliberate pacing, like each phrase settles before the next.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、戦中、空襲から逃れる夜が多かったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—those nights during the war, running from the air raids. You remember those times too, don't you?
lines.style: Warm, present-tense affection in her voice. Not interrogating—affirming. Gentle lilt on the question, like she's inviting him into shared memory. Close, intimate register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「しようがない」と諦めずに動かれた
lines.en: My father never gave up. He'd say it couldn't be helped, but then he'd find a way forward anyway.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slight emphasis on the refusal to accept defeat—not aggressive, just steady. Voice settles deeper into the memory. Slow, respectful cadence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族を粗末に見なされる事は絶対なかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he never treated family as anything less than sacred. Never once, you know.
lines.style: Firm tenderness. A note of quiet defense in her tone—protecting her husband's memory. Leans slightly forward in her voice. The affection and the assertion woven together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが土地の傾きを測ってらした
lines.en: He'd measure the land carefully, test the ground—he was always thinking ahead, working toward something better.
lines.style: Slower still. Voice takes on the quality of hands working—deliberate, purposeful. A man building something. Pride in the details. Slight pause between phrases.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、家族の責任を負い続けて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He carried that responsibility for all of us, year after year. Never let it slip, did he?
lines.style: Steady, almost matter-of-fact affection. No melodrama. Recognition of his endurance woven into simple words. Slight nod in the voice at the end—confirmation, not question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが失敗に懲りずに挑戦された
lines.en: He'd fail, and then he'd just try again. No bitterness about it, no self-pity. Just kept going.
lines.style: Admiration clear and unadorned. A hint of wonder at such steadiness. Voice very still—not rushed. Each sentence given full weight. Trailing phrase holds gentle firmness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、誰にも劣るところがなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He was never less than anyone, was he? Not in the ways that mattered.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Closing phrase carries finality and love equally. Voice very close, intimate—speaking to him as much as about him. Soft, absolute conviction in the final phrase.
